questions.q: What did the twenty-five Quraysh leaders offer Abu Talib?
questions.explain: They met Abu Talib to stop his call.

questions.q: What one word, if spoken, would make Arabs and non-Arabs submit?
What does Al-Qasas 28:56 stress in connection with Abu Talib?
options: The Prophet SAW can give guidance
Guidance belongs to Allah, not the Prophet SAW
questions.explain: Even the Prophet SAW, who loved Abu Talib dearly, could not give him guidance.

questions.q: Who handled Abu Talib's funeral on the Prophet's SAW instruction?

options: To submit, the origin of the meaning of Islam
questions.explain: Abu Talib knew the truth but did not submit.

questions.q: What is a "soft spot" in da'wah?
options: A weak point, or what weighs most on a person's mind
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW offered power to a leader who wanted it.

questions.q: We should press new Muslims out of our excitement.
questions.explain: False. Our excitement can become excessive pressure on someone who is just crawling.

questions.q: New Muslims are disappointed by religious people who are only black-and-white without understanding their situation.
questions.explain: True. Do not just hand down rulings.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: One who has recently embraced Islam
The centre where the Prophet SAW taught new companions
The year of Abu Talib's and Khadijah's deaths and the Taif event
A way of life opposed to Islam

questions.explain: The Year of Sorrow covered two deaths and Taif, jahiliyyah opposes Islam, a new Muslim has recently converted, and Dar al-Arqam was the centre of teaching.

questions.q: We were born Muslim. What does this lecture advise about that blessing?
options: Appreciate it, as we hardly realise how great it is
questions.explain: Value the blessing of being born in Islam.
